annotation.summary_en: A man tracks down a magical genie to fulfill three wishes, but his final request for a 'sharp sensation' results in a literal and painful surprise.
annotation.summary_detailed_en: In a desolate, bare winter field, a man wearing a black beanie and a leather jacket searches for a magical entity. He successfully conjures a golden, glowing, bearded genie who appears with crossed arms, announcing his readiness to serve his master. The man, unimpressed by the genie's traditional rhymes, claims he has spent a year coming up with better material. He proceeds to ask for his three wishes. His first wish is for a large sum of money, which the genie grants. His second wish is for a Mitsubishi Lancer, which he is later seen driving while filming himself on his phone. For his final wish, the man asks for 'sharp sensations' (sur zgatsoghutyunner), describing a desire for his hair to stand on end and his heart to flutter. The genie complies literally; in the final scene, as the man stands in the field, the genie suddenly stabs him in the back with a large sword. The sketch ends with the man screaming in pain as he realizes the genie took the word 'sharp' too literally.
catchphrases: երեք ցանկության մոմենտը աշխատում ա չէ՞
լսում եմ քո առաջին ցանկությունը ով իմ տիրակալ
